{{Conservatism in Russia|Intellectuals}}
'''Mikhail Zinovyevich Yuryev''' ({{langx|ru|Михаил Зиновьевич Юрьев}}; 10 April 1959 – 15 February 2019) was a Russian politician who served as a member of the [[State Duma]] between 1996 and 1999.<ref>[https://www.vesti.ru/doc.html?id=3116946 Скончался политик, бизнесмен и ведущий Михаил Юрьев] {{in lang|ru}}</ref>

Yuryev came from a Jewish family. His father Zinovy Yuryev was a science fiction writer, and his mother Yelena Korenevskaya was a journalist. After graduating from the [[MSU Faculty of Biology]] Mikhail Yuryev worked at the Institute of Molecular Genetics. In 1995-1999 he was a deputy of the [[2nd State Duma]], a member of the [[Yabloko]] faction. Yuryev was one of the [[Deputy Chairmen of the State Duma]] under [[Gennady Seleznyov]]'s chairmanship. Yuryev was an advocate of [[isolationism]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://echo.msk.ru/programs/albac/33201/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190216212153/https://echo.msk.ru/programs/albac/33201/|archive-date=2019-02-16|title=Внутренний враг и национальная идея|language=ru|trans-title=Internal enemy and national idea|website=[[Echo of Moscow]]|date=2004-11-28}}</ref>

In 2014, Yuryev announced that he had ceased his business activities in Russia.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://republic.ru/posts/40142|title=Я патриот своей страны, но деньги здесь делать неудобно|language=ru|trans-title=I am a patriot of my country, but it is inconvenient to make money here|website=[[Republic.ru]]|date=2014-04-25}}</ref> In 2018 Yuryev founded the [[American Ethane Company]] together with [[Alexander Voloshin]], former [[Kremlin Chief of Staff]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://regnum.ru/news/polit/2574138.html|title=Скончался бывший вице-спикер Госдумы Михаил Юрьев|language=ru|trans-title=Former vice-speaker of the State Duma Mikhail Yuryev passed away|website=[[REGNUM News Agency|Regnum]]|date=2019-02-15}}</ref> In his late years Yuryev hosted several political talk shows on [[Izvestia|RSN]] and [[Komsomolskaya Pravda]] stations.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://tass.ru/politika/6124210|title=Умер бывший вице-спикер Госдумы Михаил Юрьев|language=ru|trans-title=Former vice-speaker of the State Duma Mikhail Yuryev dies|website=[[TASS]]|date=2019-02-15}}</ref>
